Netflix engagement — genre insight dashboard

Every title with at least 1M views, genre-labelled. Filter, rank, and compare genres on total reach and on how a typical title in that genre performs — the two tell different stories.

Read this first. The source column named “Release Year” is the engagement report period, not when a title came out — RED (2010) sits in 2023 and Casino Royale (2006) in 2026. It is labelled Report period throughout. The 2023 period also carries ~3× the titles of later periods, so period totals are not comparable — compare shares and per-title medians instead.
